Philosophe romain. Son traité de musique: Roman philosopher. His treatise on music passed Greek interval theory to the Middle Ages.
Poète et compositeur. Sa Messe de Nostre: Poet and composer. His Messe de Nostre Dame is one of the first complete polyphonic Masses.
Imprimeur vénitien. En 1501, il imprime: Venetian printer. In 1501 he printed music with movable type.
Compositeur italien. Son Orfeo (1607) es: Italian composer. His Orfeo (1607) is one of the first operas.
Religieux minime. Il établit les lois de: Minim friar. He set out the laws of vibrating strings.
Compositeur autrichien. Il rompt avec la: Austrian composer. He broke with tonality and invented twelve-tone music.
Ingénieur de la radio française. Il inve: French radio engineer. In 1948 he invented musique concrète.
Philosophe et musicien, actif à Bagdad,: Philosopher and musician, active in Baghdad, died in Damascus. Called the “Second Teacher” after Aristotle, he wrote the Great Book of Music.
Grec de Tralles, près de l'actuelle Aydı: Greek from Tralles, near today's Aydın in Turkey. He had a song and its notes carved on a stone: the oldest known complete musical composition.
Auteur grec d'une Introduction à la musi: Greek author of an Introduction to Music of which only a fragment survives: the tables of signs for voice and instruments. It is the best source for reading Greek musical notation.
